public_requests.constructibility: owner intention kind plus arguments validated by its declared JSON Schema Draft 2020-12
public_requests.resolution: responsible owner derives a separately declared operation and exact arguments, decision, blocker, or settled response
public_requests.schema_authority: self-contained input_schema in the revision-bound capability contract; external retrieval disabled
public_requests.execution: invoke only the exact returned operation envelope

operating_projections.full: Original current owner views and capability/detail contracts.
operating_projections.compact: Resolve current mandatory owner contributions and exact selected envelopes; defer optional configuration fields, proof alternatives and Planning portability. No required action-detail fetch.
operating_projections.carried: Separate model-facing view and disposable carriage of exact selected actions/questions plus small lazy owner descriptors; no full top-level owner objects. Only the view belongs in model context.
operating_projections.session_capture: Opted-in native transport observation: capturing, identity-unavailable (requirement: AW_SESSION_LOGICAL_IDENTITY), or capture-failed, with authoritative: false. Absent when disabled. Attached after capture to the result or carried model-facing view, never semantic inputs or immutable carriage. Replaces the previous observation without warnings or history; recovery is prospective.
reference_identity: exact immutable action/question envelope, or lazy owner source identity
operating_projections.admission: References are opaque identity, not authority. Rust addresses selected owner detail before optional hydration, reobserves mandatory dependency contributions, and executes exact actions through current native admission. Compact/carried post-effect continuation uses the same frontier boundary.
operating_projections.bounded_answer: Fill only the absent answer slot of the exact current selected decision; preserve every supplied owner argument.
operating_projections.context: Carry unchanged target/task/changed/request; explicit differences require fresh start.
operating_projections.source_delivery: Optional delivered refs suppress only exact unchanged source prose after fresh owner resolution. delivery_refs bind work, source material and producing implementation. They never acknowledge understanding, reconciliation, proof or effects.
operating_projections.recovery: Unknown, changed or lost carriage requires fresh source-owner resolution; no durable registry.

capability_ownership.effects: bound to one owned domain and admitted operation
capability_ownership.claims: exclusive authority declared separately from a module contribution
capability_ownership.cross_owner_results: evidence only until the responsible owner admits a typed request

resource_procedure.request: The existing resources request optionally accepts compose: true and an exact semantic route_request for the same current work. Unresolved route-scoped destination protection returns existing owner route_requests; settled negatives and unrelated effects remain quiet. Supply fresh operation intent and the same exact path for recovery; never a retained expected_revision.
resource_procedure.composition: Check selected executable availability, obtain one native proposal, and carry its exact action through current native admission. No action loop or separate filesystem semantics.
resource_procedure.direct: operation: direct with compose: true performs zero resource-owner calls and creates no state; ordinary direct work need not call at all.
resource_procedure.judgment: Missing isolation necessity or current policy judgment yields the native proposal. Composition cannot manufacture permits-isolation.
resource_procedure.result: Native effect_outcome remains authoritative; resource_context carries the exact target/task/changed/path for fresh reentry. An owner execution error preserves that context with unknown effect outcome, never an automatic retry.

commands.name: worker
commands.description: Project bounded worker entry, expand an exact captured input, or assemble unproven return re-entry from a sealed Assignment packet.

commands.name: resources
commands.description: Inspect local hygiene or propose/execute one current resource operation; optional compose carries one exact action after current admission.

commands.name: proof-procedure
commands.description: Prepare selected proof context, or carry one exact native check through execution and current evidence admission.

commands.name: invoke
commands.description: Invoke the exact operation returned by the current owner.

options.description: Current task text; semantics remain agent-owned.
Changed paths; accepts multiple values and repetition.
Compact executable decision (default), full detail, or view plus disposable exact carriage for a thin host.
Exact immutable reference from carried output; --input supplies the machine-carried object.
JSON bounded answer for an exact carried decision reference; all owner material remains unchanged.
Exact delivery_refs already held by this continuing consumer; suppress unchanged source prose only, never owner checks or obligations.
JSON input file, or - for stdin; start accepts one current owner request or a bounded array; invoke requires an exact action.

authority.data_shapes: this JSON contract and referenced JSON Schema

proof_procedure.request: operation: prepare, execute or direct; request carries exact owner requests; invocation carries one exact native proof action. expected_revision optionally binds selected method material.
proof_procedure.composition: One explicitly selected check or one owner-established unique missing required check, exact native admission, bounded exact receipt observation, then remaining owner judgment. A sole candidate is not required; complete current alternatives and unresolved scope prevent automatic selection. Never a primary-action loop or automatic sufficiency answer.
proof_procedure.recovery: Confirmed effect remains in effect even when continuation fails. Uncertain execution requires exact native custody reentry, never a newly prepared retry.
proof_procedure.direct: Zero owner calls; no proof or claim authority.
proof_procedure.cost: public_owner_calls counts explicit public calls. Native invoke separately resolves pre-effect admission and post-effect continuation; no parallel batch or hidden automatic retry.

memory_consequences.selected_advice: Current selected small notes are delivered as bounded advisory_context; active proof procedure or explicit detail expands selected large notes. No disposition or authority is inferred.
memory_consequences.capture_recovery: One exact recoverable interrupted owner transaction exposes its existing recovery action after current scope, policy and custody admission. Original publications are not automatically replayed.

future_value_signal.source: Admitted native Verification receipt, complete JSON stdout up to 8192 bytes
future_value_signal.authority: Untrusted nomination only; agent supplies materiality and strongest-owner disposition, existing capture owner requires publication authorization.
future_value_signal.continuity: Exact Verification prerequisites travel in the disposition request; an unresolved candidate restricts claim:complete. No signal is quiet.
